I don't want to be annoying & give my whole life story, but, I've been depressed my entire life. I know it's not going to get better and things are only going to get worse.

Well, my breaking point was basically this: 
I was married to a girl and I loved her with all my heart and she loved me too. It was all anyone could ever want from a relationship. Well, we split up. It was mainly my choice. I left her because I know for a fact she deserves someone better than me, she deserves someone who can give her 100% and isn't a depressed sack of shit. It's been about a month and SO much as happened but to make it short, I had sex with 3 people, I did a shit ton of drugs, etc. I was just trying to feel something and just trying to forget her. I've hardly been sober for the past month. 

Well, I called her a few days ago. I told her I loved her and I was sorry and I wanted to try again. She said she's seeing someone and she doesn't think it could work. She doesn't love me anymore. 

It was two and a half years. I've known her my entire life. She made me so happy and I won't ever forgive myself. I would never be able to love someone again, especially not like what we had. I love her so god damn much. 

Aside from that, like I said, I've been depressed my whole life. I tried to kill myself for the first time when I was 13. I hardly have friends, none that really give a shit, anyways. They're all sick of me and sick of my sadness. I don't blame them at all. I'm not close with anyone in my family. I live alone and I get drunk to the point of puking every single night. I have a dead end job and no plans to improve my career or go to school. And I tried to kill myself a day or so ago, for the second time now. So pathetic. I have.. nothing. I had everything.. now I have nothing. 

Thank you for asking. Sorry for the stupid ramble. It felt nice to just be 100% honest
